_README: Additional / curated sanctions lists loaded ONLY by scripts/sanctions-screen.mjs (not by the watcher's strict loader). A source may be remote (`url` + `parser`) or in-repo curated (`file`, parser 'curated'). Set `enabled:false` to keep a source configured but skipped. A remote source that fails or parses 0 names, or a curated list with no entries, degrades coverage (reported loudly) — never a silent all-clear.

sources.name: Argentina — RePET Entidades (terror-linked entities)
sources._note: RePET entidades — terror-linked ENTITIES sibling of the loaded personas.json (same /xml/ dir, keyless JSON). ENABLED 2026-08-05 on source-probe evidence (run 31030989375): the runner fetched real JSON (http 200, 156KB). The feed is the UN-consolidated-list schema in JSON (FIRST_NAME holds the entity name; ENTITY_ALIAS[].ALIAS_NAME the a.k.a. names) — hence parser 'unjson' (concatenates the ordered UN name parts and captures ALIAS_NAME), NOT the generic 'json' walker which read only FIRST_NAME and dropped the aliases.

Discovery trail: Socrata rows.csv → CKAN dataset page → /dataset/download/csv (metadata export, not the table) → this /files/download/<id> resource (repointed 2026-09-19: IADB migrated the CKAN path from singular /file/download/ to plural /files/download/, same resource id, confirmed 404 on the old path and HTTP 200 on the new one against the live site). minNames 200 floors the ~1,400-row register.

sources.name: Bahrain: National Terrorism List (Official Gazette)
sources._note: ADDED 2026-09-27. Full methodology, per-entry counts, and the exact resolution used for each of the 12 entries that needed one (same-entry alias cross-reference, a document-wide-verified boilerplate phrase, or an explicit English name given in the entry itself - never a guess) is documented in the curated file's own _README and each affected entry's verification_note. Two alias variants (individual #106) had no clean in-document resolution and were explicitly omitted rather than guessed. Structural cross-check: parsed to exactly 208 individuals + 172 entities + 7 vessels, an exact match to this same source's figures as already cited elsewhere in this registry from independent prior research - strong evidence nothing was silently dropped or duplicated. Spot-verified several individually, publicly checkable names decoded correctly: Yusuf al-Qaradawi, Hassan Nasrallah, Qasem Soleimani, Khalifa Mohammed Turki Al-Subaie (a US Treasury-designated Al-Qaeda financier). minNames set to 350, just under the true 387, so a future re-fetch of this static file failing to load isn't silently mistaken for a genuine reduction, while still catching real corruption or truncation. FIELD-NAME BUG FOUND AND FIXED 2026-09-27: this entry (and the pre-existing ma-cnasnu entry, added 2026-09-26) used 'url' to point at the local curated file, but scripts/sanctions-screen.mjs's fetchListBody() only treats a source as local when the field is named 'file' - a bare 'url' falls through to `new URL(source.url)`, which throws 'Invalid URL' for a relative path. Confirmed directly by running loadSanctionsLists() against the live registry: both bh-gazette and ma-cnasnu failed with 'invalid url' before this fix, meaning ma-cnasnu has been silently degrading coverage since it was added (over a day, with nothing surfacing this beyond a generic 'coverage degraded' note). Renamed both entries' field from 'url' to 'file'; re-ran the loader and confirmed bh-gazette loads all 387 names and ma-cnasnu loads 28 (12 individuals plus their aliases as separately-matchable strings).

sources._note: ADDED 2026-09-28, DISABLED pending a source-probe run. The official FIU Belize page (fiubelize.org/consolidated-belize-sanctions-list/, read 2026-09-28 via an external fetcher) describes a consolidated list of individuals and entities subject to sanctions under Orders of the High Court of Belize, giving effect to both domestic sanctions mechanisms and UNSCR obligations (Money Laundering and Terrorism (Prevention) Act as amended 2023), published as XML, XLSX and PDF; the XLSX link was dated JULY2026 (belize_consolidated_sanctions_listJULY2026.xlsx). Official page isf.gov.lb/national-terrorism-financial-list/ links "Click here to download the list updated on 15/04/2025" -> wp-content/uploads/2025/04/en_file.xls; the link is resolved from that page on every run (discover, stem en_file), so a re-upload under a new month folder is followed. The file is a legacy Excel 97-2003 workbook (OLE2 compound file, BIFF8), read by the stdlib reader parseXlsSheets / parser lbisf. Source-probe run 37128209902 (GitHub runner, 2026-10-03) confirmed the format: HTTP 200, application/vnd.ms-excel, 137,216 bytes, D0 CF 11 E0 signature. Source-probe run 37128512274 (same day, branch claude/stoic-ride-ms3hyp @ 8cc77c8) parsed it with lbisf: 286 names, minNames met. Cross-check: an independent external fetch of the same file read 261 rows (serials 1-262, 206 absent; 240 natural persons, 19 entities, 2 untyped) under the header Serial # | First Name and Family Name | ... | Group Type | Alias Type | Regime | Listed on | ...; applying the same name/alias rules to that copy gives 286 unique names, with the same first eight names in the same order as the runner read. minNames 250 floors a parse drift without tripping on a few de-listings.

sources.name: Somalia: NAMLC national targeted financial sanctions lists (Al-Shabaab; TFS Act 2023 art. 6)
sources._note: ADDED 2026-10-03. The two lists issued by the National Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Committee (NAMLC/001/24 of 13/04/2024, 9 persons; NAMLC/002/24 of 18/07/2024, 8 persons), transcribed from the primary NAMLC PDFs. The NAMLC page namlc.gov.so/targeted-financial-sanction-list/ (read 2026-10-03) states that two lists have been issued. Curated because the lists are PDF only. Refresh procedure and verification in the file's _README / verificationNote.

sources.name: Côte d'Ivoire: CENTIF national list of persons designated as affiliated with terrorism (UNSCR 1373)
sources._note: ADDED 2026-10-03. 78 persons designated by order of the Minister of Finance and Budget (Ordonnance n° 2023-875; Décret n° 2024-216 as amended), transcribed from CENTIF's consolidated PDF (centif.ci/wp-content/uploads/2025/02/listenationale1373.pdf, update of 4 July 2025, which replaces earlier versions), linked from centif.ci/liste-des-sanctions/. sources.name: Trinidad and Tobago — FIUTT TFS Search Tool (Consolidated List of High Court Orders, ATA s.22AA)
sources._note: DIAGNOSTIC, DISABLED. Source-probe run 37129541443 (GitHub runner, 2026-10-03): the portal page answers HTTP 200 (text/html, 38,885 bytes) with a search form (POST to /unsanctionsportal/initialsubmit with a session id in the URL) and exposes no direct data-file link, so the Excel export described on fiu.gov.tt/tfs-search-tool/tfs-search-tool-2/ cannot be fetched with the single keyless GET the screen uses. sources.name: Bulgaria — BNB consolidated list under the Law on Measures against the Financing of Terrorism (art. 4b)
sources._note: DIAGNOSTIC, DISABLED. Bulgaria's national list is the annex to Council of Ministers Decision No 265 of 2003 (State Gazette No 64/2003), adopted under art. 5(1) of the Law on Measures against the Financing of Terrorism and amended many times (State Gazette Nos 86/2003, 34, 61 and 87/2004, 16/2006, 44 and 66/2016, 73/2022, 47/2023; latest Decision No 606 of 16 August 2024, State Gazette No 70 of 20 August 2024, which repeals section III item 16 — read 2026-10-03 from the BNB PDF eu_lf_eu_list_lmst_2024_bg.pdf). The BNB page publishes a consolidated PDF plus separate amendment PDFs; loading it correctly requires reconciling the consolidated text with every later amendment, which is not done yet. Not a screening source.

sources._note: ADDED 2026-10-03. sources.name: Germany — BfV: banned organisations involved in foreign-related extremism (association bans)
sources._note: ADDED 2026-10-03. Source-probe run 37147223927 (GitHub runner, 2026-10-03, suite opensanctions-catalogue) read the OpenSanctions `sanctions` collection index (95 member datasets) and this dataset's own index.json: publisher "Bundesamt für Verfassungsschutz" (official: true), 13 targets, last change 2026-09-19. These are association bans (Vereinsverbote) of foreign-related extremist organisations, i.e. national proscriptions, not financial sanctions; Germany's financial sanctions remain UN/EU (screened via those lists). Recorded 2026-10-03 as a supplementary proscription source. Disabled for sanctions screening because this is a national proscription / association-ban feed, not a financial-sanctions list; keeping it enabled would overstate national sanctions-source depth.
